items.series: T-PLUS P2 It really happened, on the clock
items.hypothesis: TP-B1 P2: DOCUMENTARY_STORY on the live clock; primary = public views at 48 h.
items.caption:
The loudest sound in history, heard nearly 4,800 km away.
Krakatoa, 27 Aug 1883: a gauge 160 km away went off its scale; barometers recorded the wave up to 7 times (Royal Society, 1888). Times computed.
